verdict.rationale: Claude Design is a SaaS design tool that could plausibly publish an API reference, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents no API reference, runnable examples, or interactive API explorer. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and the only machine-readable docs found are help-center llms.txt and markdown articles, not an API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
